images.alt: Masterpiece, ultra-photorealistic cinematic action photograph of a beautiful female angelic Roman legionnaire charging directly toward the viewer through the ruins of an ancient temple, captured head-to-toe in a powerful dynamic forward stride. She wears intricately engraved, battle-worn bronze-and-steel legionnaire armor, sculpted breastplate, armored greaves, leather battle skirt, and an ornate crested Roman helmet with a deep crimson plume. Her intense eyes face directly toward the camera, expression fierce and determined, skin naturally weathered with dust and battle grime. Enormous ivory feathered angel wings spread dramatically behind her, individually detailed feathers illuminated by brilliant golden backlight. She thrusts an ancient sword forward in one hand while carrying a richly engraved round shield in the other, crimson cape whipping violently behind her. Shattered columns, monumental temple ruins, broken stone, drifting dust and glowing embers surround her beneath dramatic storm clouds pierced by celestial golden sunlight.
